values.task_boundary: Implement only DRT-01 within its exact owned paths and authority boundary.
deliverables: Versioned topology and scenario manifest for both live windows.
Producer-derived receipt, resource, timing, cleanup, and claim schema with negative-case denominator.
acceptance_criteria: The contract names exactly three voters, three governed agents, one non-voting Shepherd, and one quorum-leased Observatory.
Every node has distinct identity, credential, port, state root, storage, and failure-domain placement.
Each scenario has setup, action, expected commit/election/fence behavior, timeout, receipt fields, cleanup, and fail-closed outcome.
The contract distinguishes production proof from harness orchestration and forbids in-process substitutes or hard-coded success counts.
dependencies: No child dependency; setup issue #146 and umbrella readiness only
non_goals: Treating a topology diagram as proof
